newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia banks, Spasskiye Vorota sign agreement.
newsitem.headline: Russia banks, Spasskiye Vorota sign agreement.

text.p: The Association of Russian Banks and Russian insurer Strakhovaya Gruppa Spasskiye Vorota signed an agreement to promote the company's services among banks, the company said on Wednesday.

The Association will consider Spasskiye Vorota the main insurer for plastic card holders and will recommend members of the Association to use Spasskiye Vorota's services in this area, it said in a statement.
Spasskiye Vorota will consider deals with member banks of the Association as a priority, it said.
Spasskiye Vorota is part of the Most finance-industrial group, led by Most-Bank. Its authorised capital is 12 billion roubles.
The Association recently signed an agreement with Russia's second biggest insurer SAO Ingosstrakh, promoting its services for insuring real estate, cash transport and equipment among member banks.
